subject: Expression of interest: graduate civil drafter or drafting trainee, Marc Masarate
notes: SPECULATIVE_ENQUIRY after SEEK sweeps at 3, 7 and 14 days (max details 80) and employers rotation left only one new publishable advert (SGP Bendigo). Costin Roe careers page invites CV emails for drafting traineeships and graduate pathways.
email_body:
Hello,

This is a speculative enquiry, not a reply to an advertised vacancy. Your careers page invites people to email a CV for drafting and graduate pathways, including civil and structural drafting traineeships, so I wanted to introduce myself.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and interstate work where relocation is agreed.

Your in-house civil and structural drafting teams, and the chance to learn under senior CAD draftspeople, match the drafting start I am looking for. My drafting so far is from study rather than a paid Australian role.

Would you keep me in mind for a graduate civil drafting or drafting trainee opening, now or later? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

paragraphs: I would like to ask whether Costin Roe Consulting has room for a graduate civil drafter or drafting trainee. This is a speculative enquiry rather than a reply to an advertised vacancy, sent to mail@costinroe.com.au because your careers page invites CV emails for drafting and graduate pathways.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). My CAD work so far is from study rather than commercial production drafting.
From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and field engineer, reviewing drawings, doing inspections and keeping site and material records.

I live in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am open to discussing relocation to Sydney for the right drafting role.
I have attached my resume and cover letter and would welcome the chance to be kept on file for a drafting trainee or graduate civil drafting opening.
